verdict.rationale: Ramp's AI page says its agents "scan transactions in real-time for anomalies" and "flag anything unclear or risky immediately for your review." It also describes AI teammates "flagging fraud... and enforcing policy" and a dedicated fraud-prevention agent, which matches the story directly. The evidence is marketing-level only, though webhooks for "anomaly conditions" add a route for custom alerting. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how anomaly and out-of-policy detection works (policy rule configuration, review queue behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the flagging works as claimed.
